  tagline = 'You''ll like her when she''s angry. Marvel''s first legal comedy breaks the fourth wall — and the internet.',
  description = 'She-Hulk: Attorney at Law follows Jennifer Walters, a lawyer specializing in superhuman cases, as she navigates her new life as a Hulk while dealing with dating, online trolls, and the challenge of being taken seriously.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/she-hulk-featured-8BqLmYXKdRxTxYKB7mWnXZ.webp',

Charlie Cox''s return as Matt Murdock in the yellow suit made those specific cards highly sought-after.',
  keyCards = '- **2023 Upper Deck She-Hulk Daredevil Yellow Suit** — Charlie Cox MCU return, $15-35\n- **2023 Upper Deck She-Hulk Tatiana Maslany Auto** — Emmy-winning actress autograph, $60-150+\n- **2023 Upper Deck She-Hulk Wong Cards** — Benedict Wong crossover, $5-12',
  content = '## Marvel''s Legal Comedy\n\nShe-Hulk was Marvel''s boldest experiment — a half-hour legal comedy that broke the fourth wall, commented on its own franchise, and directly addressed the toxic fandom discourse happening in real-time.\n\n## Daredevil Returns\n\nCharlie Cox''s return as Matt Murdock — now in the classic yellow suit — was the show''s most universally praised element.   metaDescription = 'She-Hulk: Attorney at Law (2022) guide — legal comedy breakdown, Daredevil return, fourth wall breaks, and trading card values.',
  keywords = 'she-hulk, tatiana maslany, jennifer walters, daredevil, charlie cox, disney plus marvel, marvel cards, legal comedy',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel She-Hulk Daredevil cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Do I need to watch She-Hulk before Daredevil Born Again?","answer":"Not strictly required, but She-Hulk features Charlie Cox''s Daredevil in a significant role and establishes his lighter MCU characterization."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'she-hulk-2022';

UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'James Gunn',
  `cast` = 'Chris Pratt as Peter Quill / Star-Lord, Dave Bautista as Drax, Pom Klementieff as Mantis, Kevin Bacon as Himself, Vin Diesel as Groot (voice), Bradley Cooper as Rocket (voice)',

  cardMarketContent = '## Holiday Special Cards: Festive Guardians Collectibles\n\nThe Holiday Special cards are fun seasonal collectibles featuring the Guardians in Christmas settings. Kevin Bacon cards are novelty items that collectors love.',
  keyCards = '- **2023 Upper Deck GotG Holiday Special Kevin Bacon** — Novelty celebrity card, $5-15\n- **2023 Upper Deck GotG Holiday Mantis/Drax** — Buddy comedy duo card, $3-10',
  content = '## The Perfect Holiday Special\n\nJames Gunn delivered exactly what fans wanted — a warm, funny, slightly absurd holiday special. Mantis and Drax kidnapping Kevin Bacon is the kind of premise only Guardians could pull off.\n\n## Mantis''s Secret\n\nThe special revealed that Mantis is Peter Quill''s half-sister — they share Ego as a father.   metaDescription = 'Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special (2022) guide — Kevin Bacon kidnapping, Mantis reveal, holiday fun, and trading card values.',
  keywords = 'guardians galaxy holiday special, kevin bacon, mantis, drax, james gunn, disney plus marvel, christmas, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Guardians Holiday Special cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is the Holiday Special required viewing before Vol. 3?","answer":"It is recommended viewing as it establishes the Guardians'' current status, reveals Mantis as Peter''s sister, and shows how they acquired Knowhere as their base."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'gotg-holiday-special-2022';

  director = 'Various (showrunner: Jeff Trammell)',

  episodeCount = 10, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',

  cardMarketContent = '## Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man Cards: Animated Excellence\n\nThis animated series surprised everyone with its quality. The unique art style makes these cards visually distinct, and Colman Domingo''s Norman Osborn cards are particularly sought-after.',
  keyCards = '- **2025 Upper Deck Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man Base** — Unique animated art style, $5-15\n- **2025 Upper Deck FNSM Norman Osborn** — Colman Domingo voiced villain, $8-20',
  content = '## A Fresh Spider-Man Origin\n\nYour Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man reimagined Peter Parker''s origin in an alternate timeline where Norman Osborn becomes his mentor instead of Tony Stark.   metaDescription = 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man (2025) guide — animated origin, Norman Osborn mentor twist, and trading card values.',
  keywords = 'friendly neighborhood spider-man, animated, peter parker, norman osborn, colman domingo, disney plus marvel, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man animated cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is this connected to Tom Holland''s Spider-Man?","answer":"No, this is set in an alternate timeline where Peter Parker''s origin unfolds differently, with Norman Osborn as his mentor instead of Tony Stark."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'friendly-neighborhood-spider-man-2025';
